props.precision: Approximate — exact for isogeny graphs, approximate for LPS expanders

props.rh_connection: RH is equivalent to the spectral gap of L_s

props.proof_technique: polynomial theory, arithmetic of Dirichlet series

properties.name: Alon-Boppana Bound
properties.statement: For any infinite family of d-regular graphs: lim inf |λ₂(G_n)| ≥ 2√(d-1)
properties.description: Ramanujan graphs ACHIEVE the Alon-Boppana bound — they are optimal expanders

properties.name: Baez-Duarte Criterion
properties.statement: RH iff χ ∈ closure(span{ρ_a : a ∈ N}) in L²(0,∞), where χ is the indicator of (0,1] — countable version of Nyman-Beurling
properties.description: Luis Báez-Duarte strengthened Nyman-Beurling from uncountable to countable generating set. Numerical evidence by Báez-Duarte up to a=100.

properties.name: Bagchi's Theorem
properties.statement: RH holds iff the Hurwitz zeta function ζ(s,a) is cyclic in L²(0,1) with respect to the translation semigroup
properties.description: Bhaskar Bagchi (1982). Reformulates Nyman-Beurling in terms of dynamical systems on L². Connects RH to ergodic theory.

properties.name: Balazard-Saias-Yor Integral
properties.description: A cleaner integral on the critical line itself. If ζ has a zero off the line, the integral is positive.

properties.name: Bombieri Variational Approach
properties.statement: RH equivalent to existence of minimizing function for Bombieri's variational functional on the explicit formula
properties.description: Enrico Bombieri (2000, 2003). Generalizes Weil positivity via calculus of variations. Connected to Connes' noncommutative geometry trace formula.

properties.name: Brownian Excursion (Biane-Pitman-Yor)
properties.statement: E[Z_s] = Ξ(s) where Z_s = ∫₀^∞ cos(st)|B_u|du for Brownian excursion B_u. RH connects to moment conditions.
properties.description: P. Biane, J. Pitman, M. Yor (2001). The Riemann Ξ-function has a probabilistic interpretation via Brownian excursion area.

properties.name: Caveney-Nicolas-Sondow GA1/GA2 Criterion
properties.statement: The only number that is both GA1 (composite N with G(N)≥G(N/p) ∀p|N) and GA2 (G(N)≥G(aN) ∀a) is 4, where G(n) = σ(n)/(n log log n)
properties.description: Refinement of Robin's inequality. Connected to colossally abundant numbers.

properties.name: CayleyPy API — SL(2,F_p) Generation
properties.statement: CayleyPy provides MatrixGenerator(modulo=p) with special_linear_fundamental_roots(2, p) → 4 generators E₁₂, E₂₁ and inverses. BFS produces edges_list (numpy), adjacency_matrix_sparse(), all_states.
properties.description: Verified API: special_linear_fundamental_roots generates 4 generators from positive/negative root spaces. BfsResult provides edges_list, adjacency_matrix_sparse(), save/load. to_networkx_graph() materializes full graph (no truncation). Pre-computed data for p=2..10 in repo.

properties.name: Chebyshev ψ Error Term
properties.statement: ψ(x) = x + O(x^{1/2} log²x), where ψ(x) = Σ_{n≤x} Λ(n)
properties.description: Equivalent to RH via explicit formula. Stronger than PNT (ψ(x) ~ x).

properties.name: De Bruijn-Newman Constant Λ = 0
properties.statement: RH iff Λ = 0, where H(λ,z) has only real zeros iff λ ≥ Λ. Rodgers-Tao proved Λ ≥ 0, so RH ↔ Λ = 0
properties.description: de Bruijn (1950): Λ ≤ 1/2. Newman (1976): Λ exists, conjectured ≥ 0. Rodgers-Tao (2020): Λ ≥ 0. Gap closed to Λ = 0.
properties.key_paper: Rodgers, Tao (2020) Forum Math. Pi 8, e6

properties.proof_technique: Étale cohomology, proof of Weil conjectures
properties.statement: Hecke eigenvalues of cusp forms satisfy |a_p| ≤ 2p^{(k-1)/2}
properties.name: Deligne Bound
properties.description: THE fundamental bound connecting modular forms and graph spectral theory. For k=2: |a_p| ≤ 2√p = Ramanujan bound |λ| ≤ 2√(d-1)

properties.name: Divisibility Graph Criterion
properties.statement: RH equivalent to spectral properties of the divisibility graph (vertices 1..N, edges n→m if n|m)
properties.description: K.A. Broughan. The divisibility graph's spectral radius behavior encodes RH.
properties.key_paper: Broughan (2017) Equivalents of RH Vol I, Ch. 10

properties.name: Explicit Formula
properties.statement: ψ₀(x) = x - Σ_ρ x^ρ/ρ - log(2π) - ½log(1 - x⁻²), where ψ₀(x) = Σ_{n≤x} Λ(n) (Chebyshev function), ρ runs over non-trivial zeros
properties.description: THE central formula connecting prime distribution to zeta zeros. Von Mangoldt. RH equivalent to ψ(x) = x + O(x^{1/2+ε}).

properties.name: Franel-Landau Criterion
properties.statement: D(N) = O(N^{1/2+ε}) where D(N) = |#{squarefree n≤N : ω(n) even} - #{squarefree n≤N : ω(n) odd}|
properties.description: Balance of squarefree integers with even vs. odd number of prime factors. Elementary formulation.

properties.name: Generalized Riemann Hypothesis
properties.statement: All non-trivial zeros of Dirichlet L-functions L(s,χ) have real part 1/2
properties.description: Extends RH to all Dirichlet L-functions

properties.name: Hardy-Littlewood Series
properties.description: Asymptotic behavior of odd zeta values in exponential generating function.

properties.note: NOT proven equivalent to RH — it's a sufficient condition. If such an operator exists, RH follows, but the converse is unclear.
properties.name: Hilbert-Pólya Conjecture
properties.statement: The imaginary parts of the non-trivial zeros of ζ(s) are the eigenvalues of a self-adjoint operator (Hermitian matrix) on a Hilbert space
properties.description: If true, RH follows because self-adjoint operators have real eigenvalues → Im(ρ) real → Re(ρ) = 1/2. Yakaboylu (2023) constructed a Hamiltonian with real eigenvalues under certain conditions.

props.description: Self-adjoint operator has real spectrum → zeros on critical line

properties.name: Horocycle Flow Ergodicity Rate
properties.statement: ∫₀^T f(h_t z)dt = T∫f + O(T^{1/2+ε}) for nice f on SL(2,R)/SL(2,Z) iff RH
properties.description: D. Mayer. The rate of equidistribution of horocycle flows on the modular surface encodes RH. Connects dynamical systems to number theory.
properties.key_paper: Mayer (1990); noted by Zagier; Lagarias (2010) Clay Math. Proc.

properties.note: The RH-analogue status comes from the STRUCTURAL parallel: eigenvalue bound ↔ zero location bound
properties.name: IH-RH (Ihara Riemann Hypothesis)
properties.statement: A d-regular graph is Ramanujan iff all non-trivial eigenvalues λ satisfy |λ| ≤ 2√(d-1)
properties.description: Proven independently by Alon-Boppana (lower bound) and Lubotzky-Phillips-Sarnak (achievable). NOT an analogue in the sense of being unproven — it's a theorem about graphs.

props.shared_representation: Both follow from representation theory of GL(2) over p-adic fields (Deligne for modular forms, same machinery for LPS)
props.description: Structural parallel: Ramanujan bound |λ| ≤ 2√(d-1) ↔ RH critical line Re(s)=1/2. Both are optimal eigenvalue/zero location statements.

properties.statement: All Jensen polynomials J_{d,0}(x) for the Taylor coefficients of Ξ(t) are hyperbolic (all roots real) for all d ≥ 1
properties.name: Jensen Polynomial Hyperbolicity (Pólya-Jensen)
properties.description: Pólya (1927) established equivalence. Griffin-Ono-Rolen-Zagier (2019) proved hyperbolicity for n ≥ N(d) — computational evidence supporting RH.

properties.name: LPS Ramanujan Graph Construction
properties.statement: For every prime p ≡ 1 (mod 4), there exist p+1-regular Ramanujan graphs on SL(2,F_q)
properties.description: Constructs Ramanujan graphs as Cayley graphs of PSL(2,F_q) with p+1 generators. Uses deep results from representation theory of SL(2).

properties.name: LPS Spectral Bridge
properties.statement: The adjacency operator of the LPS Cayley graph of PSL(2,F_p) acts on L²(Γ\G/K) as an approximation to the Hecke operator
properties.description: THE bridge between graph spectral theory and number theory. For k=2 cusp forms, Deligne bound |a_p| ≤ 2√p = Ramanujan bound |λ| ≤ 2√(d-1) because both arise from the same GL(2,ℚ_p) representations.

props.description: Connects adjacency eigenvalues of Cayley graphs to Hecke eigenvalues of modular forms

properties.name: Lagarias Inequality
properties.statement: σ(n) ≤ H_n + exp(H_n) log(H_n) for all n ≥ 1, with equality only for n=1
properties.description: An equivalent formulation of RH using harmonic numbers

properties.name: Laguerre-Pólya Class
properties.statement: The Riemann Ξ-function belongs to the Laguerre-Pólya class — the uniform limit on compacts of polynomials with only real zeros
properties.description: G. Pólya (1927), I. Schur. If RH is true, Ξ is in LP class. Equivalent statement about Hadamard product factorization.

properties.name: Landau Function Criterion
properties.statement: log g(n) < li^{-1}(n) for all n ≥ 1, where g(n) = maximal order of element in symmetric group S_n
properties.description: M. Deleglise, J.-L. Nicolas (2019). Connects RH to combinatorics of permutations.

properties.statement: RH holds iff λ_n = Σ_ρ (1 - (1 - 1/ρ)^n) ≥ 0 for all n ∈ N, where ρ runs over non-trivial zeros of ζ(s)
properties.name: Li's Criterion
properties.description: Xian-Jin Li (1998). Gives an infinite sequence of non-negativity conditions equivalent to RH. Related to the explicit formula.

properties.name: Lindelöf Hypothesis
properties.statement: ζ(1/2 + it) = O(t^ε) for all ε > 0
properties.description: Weaker than RH but still unproven. Equivalent to bounds on moments of ζ(s).

properties.name: Liouville λ Limit Criterion
properties.statement: Σ_{k=1}^n λ(k) = O(n^{1/2+ε}) for all ε > 0, where λ is Liouville function
properties.description: Liouville function λ(n) = (-1)^{Ω(n)}. Closely related to Mertens function.

properties.name: Mertens Hypothesis
properties.statement: |M(x)| = |Σ_{n≤x} μ(n)| < √x for all x > 1
properties.description: Conjectured by Mertens (1897). Disproven by Odlyzko & te Riele (1985): M(x) = Ω±(√x) infinitely often. But it's STRONGER than RH — if it were true, RH would follow. Its failure doesn't disprove RH.
properties.key_paper: Odlyzko & te Riele 1985, Journal für die reine und angewandte Mathematik

props.description: Mertens hypothesis implies RH, but Mertens is FALSE

properties.name: Möbius Randomness (Chowla Conjecture)
properties.statement: Σ_{n≤x} μ(n) μ(n+h) = o(x) for all fixed h ≠ 0
properties.description: Sarvadaman Chowla. Möbius function is random (uncorrelated at shifts). Stronger than PNT. Connected to Sarnak's conjecture on deterministic sequences.

props.description: Chowla implies PNT (via partial summation), but NOT equivalent to RH

properties.name: Nicolas Criterion
properties.statement: RH holds iff Σ_{d|n} d ≥ H_n + exp(H_n) log(H_n) for all n ≥ 2, where H_n is the nth harmonic number
properties.description: Jean-Louis Nicolas. Related to Robin's inequality but using the harmonic numbers. Equivalent to RH.

properties.statement: RH holds iff the functions {f_a(x) = {ax} - a⌊x⌋ : a ∈ (0,1]} span L²(0,1)
properties.name: Nyman-Beurling Criterion
properties.description: RH equivalent to the density of shifted fractional part functions in L²(0,1). Key bridge for neural network approaches (Hayou 2023).

properties.name: Pollicott Farey Graph Theorem
properties.statement: RH is equivalent to the spectral gap of the transfer operator on the Farey graph: Z_{Γ₁}(s) = det(1 - L_{2s})
properties.description: Encodes RH as a graph spectral property. The Farey graph provides a SECOND bridge from graphs to ζ(s), independent of LPS.

props.proof_technique: dynamical systems, transfer operators, thermodynamic formalism

properties.name: Prime Number Theorem
properties.statement: π(x) ~ x/log(x)
properties.description: Formalized in Mathlib via Wiener-Ikehara theorem. PNT+ project by Kontorovich and Tao.

props.description: PNT follows from non-vanishing of ζ(s) on Re(s)=1, which is weaker than RH

properties.statement: |τ(p)| ≤ 2p^{11/2} for all primes p
properties.name: Ramanujan Conjecture (original)
properties.description: Ramanujan's conjecture on the tau function, proven by Deligne as consequence of Weil conjectures

properties.name: Ramanujan-Petersson Conjecture
properties.statement: For normalized Hecke eigenform f of weight k: |a_p(f)| ≤ 2p^{(k-1)/2}
properties.description: Generalization to all cusp forms. Proven by Deligne for holomorphic forms via étale cohomology.

properties.name: Rankin-Selberg Method
properties.statement: L(s, f × g) = ζ(2s) Σ a_n(f) a_n(g) n^{-s} — convolution L-function
properties.description: Method for studying L-functions via integration against Eisenstein series. Used to relate Eisenstein L-functions to ζ(s).

properties.name: Redheffer Matrix Criterion
properties.statement: |det(A_n)| = O(n^{1/2+ε}) where A_{ij}=1 if j=1 or i|j, 0 otherwise. Since det(A_n) = M(n), this is equivalent to Mertens bound.
properties.description: R. Redheffer. Matrix formulation of Mertens function. All non-trivial eigenvalues in unit disk ↔ RH.

properties.statement: All non-trivial zeros of ζ(s) have real part 1/2
properties.name: Riemann Hypothesis
properties.description: One of the Clay Millennium Problems. Equivalent to >100 known formulations.

props.description: GRH implies RH (restricts to principal character)

properties.name: Robin's Inequality
properties.statement: σ(n) < e^γ n log log n for all n ≥ 5041 iff RH holds
properties.description: RH equivalent to Robin's inequality holding for all n ≥ 5041

properties.name: Sato-Tate Conjecture
properties.statement: For non-CM elliptic curve E/Q, the normalized Frobenius traces a_p/√p are equidistributed in [-1,1] with respect to (1/π)√(1-x²)dx
properties.description: Proved by Barnet-Lamb, Geraghty, Harris, Taylor (2011). Connects distribution of eigenvalues to the Sato-Tate measure.

properties.name: Speiser's Criterion
properties.statement: RH equivalent to absence of non-trivial zeros of ζ'(s) to the left of the critical line Re(s) = 1/2
properties.description: Andreas Speiser (1934). The derivative ζ'(s) has no zeros with Re(s) < 1/2 iff RH holds. Quantified by Levinson-Montgomery (1974).

properties.name: Sunada's Theorem
properties.statement: Two Riemannian manifolds are isospectral if their fundamental groups have nearly conjugate representations
properties.description: Extended to graphs: Sunada isospectrality. Used to construct isospectral non-isomorphic graphs.

properties.name: Volchkov Integral
properties.description: V.V. Volchkov. A single integral equation equivalent to RH. Elegant but computationally hard.

properties.name: Voronin Universality Theorem
properties.statement: For any ε > 0, any analytic function f(s) non-vanishing on the strip {1/2 < Re(s) < 1}, there exists τ > 0 such that max_{|s-3/4|≤r} |ζ(s+iτ) - f(s)| < ε
properties.description: Sergei Voronin (1975). The Riemann zeta function is universal — it can approximate any non-vanishing analytic function in any right-half of the critical strip. Striking implication: if RH is false, the universality domain changes.

properties.name: Weil Positivity Criterion
properties.statement: RH holds iff the function F(z) = Σ_ρ x^ρ + (analytic terms) is positive-definite on the multiplicative group
properties.description: André Weil showed that RH for curves over finite fields follows from a positivity condition on associated zeta functions. This inspired the entire Langlands program.

properties.name: Yakaboylu Hamiltonian Construction
properties.statement: Constructs a quantum Hamiltonian H with real eigenvalues (under conditions) whose spectrum encodes zeta zeros
properties.description: Yakaboylu (2023) partially realized Hilbert-Pólya. Shows real eigenvalues under certain conditions. No ML work on operator search exists — open gap.

properties.name: lcm Formulation
properties.statement: |log lcm(1,2,...,n) - n| < √n log²n for all n ≥ 3
properties.description: Follows from explicit formula. Elementary formulation in terms of least common multiple.

properties.name: von Koch Error Term
properties.statement: π(x) = Li(x) + O(x^{1/2} log x)
properties.description: RH equivalent to the classical prime counting error bound. The tightest possible bound from RH.

props.strategy: RH ≡ density of single-layer NNs via Nyman-Beurling
